tweets.text:
My mom was really nervous to accept delivery of her new Tesla Model Y today in Grand Rapids, Michigan. When she arrived 15 minutes early, none of the staff gave her a warm welcome. They wouldn’t even go out to the car with her. She was really disappointed & she became even more anxious feeling like she was completely alone. She asked if someone could help her to show her the car and the staff didn’t give her a straight answer, just saying she could go out there to look at it on her own and come back in to sign the papers when she was ready. She called me in a panic and felt like her worst nightmare was coming true. Long story short, the delivery experience was horrible for her. 😓 Things turned around when one of the technicians came out to help her eventually. She expressed her disappointment to him and explained how she felt. 

It’s not right for the Tesla staff to do this to first time owners, especially when they ask for help and explain that it’s their first Tesla. I assumed the staff was really busy or something, or that they were short on people, but it appears that wasn’t the case. @tesla_na @tesla - You can do better than that. Shame on your staff for this horrible experience. 

With that aside, the car is great and doesn’t have any problems.
